title: Claude soch raha ho tab ad se paise
content:
Bhai, Claude se 100 dollar kama sakte ho.

Main Claude use kar raha tha.
Prompt diya, aur woh thinking mode mein chala gaya.
Us thinking mode ki jagah ad laga sakte ho.
Ad se roz 200 dollar tak aa sakte hain.

Step by step guide chahiye, aur tool ka link chahiye, to comment kar do, tool.
Reel share kar dena.
Details seedhe DM mein aa jaayengi.
WhatsApp channel se bhi le sakte ho.
Link bio mein hai.
